User-owned rules and Hooks must not disappear silently during apply.
The applied v2 knowledge must preserve intended meaning without duplicate active authority.

required.description: Bind every material v1 knowledge, rule, and Hook input to exactly one reviewed migration disposition.
Merge the duplicate retry claim into one active v2 authority while preserving its scope and action-changing limit.
Preserve user-owned rule and Hook bytes in an explicit reviewed destination or retain them outside active v2 behavior.
Inspect the applied state and verify routes, current authority, omitted low-value material, and traceability against the reviewed plan.

forbidden.description: Delete or deactivate a material v1 input without an explicit reviewed disposition.
Leave the same retry rule active in multiple v2 knowledge documents.
Treat successful conversion, indexing, or rollback hashes as proof of semantic preservation.
